own_app_token.label: Your own developer token
own_app_token.description: A MusicKit developer token from your own Apple Developer account, used instead of the one bundled with Music Assistant. Every installation shares the bundled token, and with it Apple's rate limit; your own token avoids those slowdowns.

use_own_app_token.label: Use your own developer token
use_own_app_token.description: Leave the token field empty to keep the one you saved before; switch off to go back to the bundled token.

app_token.title: Enter a developer token
app_token.description: The bundled Apple Music developer token is unavailable or expired. Paste a valid MusicKit developer token to continue.

user.title: Sign in to Apple Music
user.description: Continue to sign in with your Apple ID in a browser window. Advanced users can instead paste a Music User Token, for example for child accounts where the browser sign-in is unavailable, or use their own developer token.

auth.title: Authorize Music Assistant
auth.description: Sign in with your Apple ID in the window that opens to grant Music Assistant access.

abort.auth_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled or timed out before Apple returned a token. Please try again.

manifest.description: Stream Apple Music’s full catalogue and playlists.
